products.name: Vintage Denim Jacket
products.description: Classic vintage denim jacket with authentic distressed finish
products.details: Made from 100% cotton denim that has been carefully processed to achieve an authentic vintage look with natural fade patterns and strategic distressing. The jacket features a regular fit that works well over t-shirts or layered over hoodies for cooler weather. Pre-shrunk construction ensures consistent sizing wash after wash. Metal hardware and reinforced stitching at stress points guarantee long-lasting durability. products.name: Premium Leather Boots
products.description: Handcrafted leather boots with superior quality and durability
products.details: Constructed from full-grain leather that molds to your foot over time for a personalized fit. The Goodyear welt construction allows for resoling, extending the boot's lifespan for years of wear. Features a cushioned leather insole and a durable rubber outsole with deep treads for traction. Expect a break-in period of 1-2 weeks of regular wear for optimal comfort. Sizing runs slightly large; consider going down half a size for a snug fit. Regular conditioning with leather cream will maintain the rich finish and prevent cracking. These boots are built to last and develop a beautiful patina with age.
